career_risk_cards.callout: The biggest career risk is not AI but systematization plus outsourcing. Standard administration is absorbed, while people who coordinate and control costs become more resilient.
career_risk_cards.fact: The risks in this occupation come from tools and outsourcing. Asset management, scheduling, and meeting logistics become systematized or outsourced, absorbing standardized work. Managers who coordinate, respond to problems, and control costs remain resilient.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable systems become, managers still coordinate across departments, solve on-site problems, and manage vendors. Human judgment plans the response and human communication aligns the organization. People remain essential to smooth operations.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「系统化 + 外包」——标准行政被吃，能统筹控成本的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位风险是工具与外包——资产、排班、会务被系统化和外包吃掉标准活；能统筹、能应变、能控成本的经理仍稳。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，跨部门怎么统筹、现场怎么救火、供应商怎么管，最后还是经理的脑去想、嘴去联——运转顺不顺，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but remaining in basic care. Grooming or training credentials can turn an entry-level cleaner into a skilled professional.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risks are not AI but occupational health and the earnings ceiling. Animal bites and scratches, fur allergies, sanitation and disease-prevention hazards, low base pay, and heavy workloads contribute to high turnover.
risks: A low earnings ceiling, with basic care roles dependent on commissions
Occupational health risks such as animal bites, scratches, and fur allergies
Sanitation and disease-prevention responsibilities that leave no room for careless disinfection
Heavy physical demands and high employee turnover
Price competition that puts pressure on small pet businesses

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can schedule appointments and identify pet breeds, but caregivers still have to decide how much to feed an abandoned puppy, how to calm it, and whether it needs to be repositioned during the night. Pets cannot speak, so only people can bring the human touch this work requires.

responsibilities: Feed animals and observe their condition
Walk animals and provide bathing and grooming care
Record health information and serve customers

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「停在基础照护」——考下美容或训练证书，才能从铲屎官变成专业人士。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「职业健康与收入天花板」——动物抓咬、毛发过敏、卫生防疫风险，以及行业普遍的低底薪高劳动强度，人员流动性大。
risks: 收入天花板低，纯照护岗靠提成
动物抓咬与毛发过敏等职业健康风险
卫生防疫责任，消毒不能马虎
体力消耗大，人员流动率高
行业低价竞争，小门店生存压力

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能帮你排预约、识别宠物品种，但那只刚被遗弃的小狗该喂多少、怎么安抚、夜里翻不翻身——这些还得靠照护人员的手和心。宠物说不出话，所以这份职业的温度，只能由人给。

career_risk_cards.callout: The largest career risk is not AI alone but AI combined with tighter university hiring. Basic drawing instruction is being automated, while educators with academic and professional depth remain more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The main career risk is not direct AI replacement. AI image generation and parametric tools lower the barrier to basic drawing and reduce the value of drawing-only instruction. Educators who lead research, practice professionally, and guide complex designs remain more secure.
risks: AI image generation lowers the barrier

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable tools become, teachers still decide how to develop a design, guide a student, and set a research direction. Human minds frame the work, human voices explain it, and human hands provide critique.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「AI + 编制收紧」——基础绘图授课被吃，有学术与执业深度的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI 直接取代，而是 AI 出图与参数化工具降低基础绘图门槛，纯「画图授课」的价值被压缩；能带科研、做实践、指导复杂方案的人更稳。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管工具多聪明，方案怎么推敲、学生怎么带、科研往哪走，最后还是教师的脑去想、嘴去讲、手去改——育人这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The largest career risk is not AI but digitization pressure combined with limited public positions. Arrangement-only roles are disappearing as value concentrates in appraisal and digital preservation.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest career risk is not AI but digitization pressure combined with limited public positions. OCR and automated description take over substantial data entry, reducing arrangement-only roles. Archivists with curation and digital preservation skills remain more secure.
risks: OCR and automated description reduce data-entry roles
Limited public positions and slow promotion
Use of physical records is declining

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable systems become, people still determine value, protect authenticity, and accept responsibility for loss. Human stewardship remains essential to memory.

responsibilities: Arrange and describe records and create finding aids
Respond to access needs and curate exhibitions

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「数字化挤压 + 编制有限」——纯整理岗在消失，价值在向鉴定与数字保存集中。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「数字化挤压 + 编制有限」——OCR 与自动编目接管了大量录入，纯整理岗在减少，懂策展与数字保存的人更稳。
risks: OCR 与自动编目压缩录入岗

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，价值还是人定的、原始性还是人守的、丢失还是人担的——记忆这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but automation + cycles. Systems replace routine cruising, while people capable of responsibility have a more stable position.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI but automation + shipping cycles. Autonomous systems take over routine navigation, while shipping demand fluctuates. People remain essential for complex waterways and accountability.
risks: Automated cruising takes over routine work

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable systems become, officers still judge which waterways are hazardous, how to dock safely, and how to respond to emergencies. Their eyes observe, their hands control the vessel, and their judgment decides the response. People remain essential on the bridge.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「自动 + 周期」——巡航被系统替，有负责力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「自动化 + 周期」——自动驾驶吃常规航行，且航运周期波动；但复杂水道与责任仍要人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪段水道要紧、怎么把船靠稳、突发怎么处置，最后还是驾驶员的眼去看、手去操、脑去决——驾驶台这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.可控: Use AI for speed, shift toward judgment

career_risk_cards.callout: Risk remains manageable when workers respect accountability boundaries + continue learning. The defensible value of Chefs and head cooks lies in execution and judgment, not repetition.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI but low-risk exposure + accountability boundaries. Chefs and head cooks still make judgments and perform final review, while AI handles structured tasks.
risks: Accountability and compliance-boundary pressure in Chefs and head cooks work.
Structurable tasks are being replaced faster by AI.
Industry swings and tighter headcount or posts.
Knowledge turns over quickly and needs constant refreshing.

career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大风险不在 AI，而在「低风险敞口 + 责任边界」——主厨与厨师长适合谁？的判断与终审仍由人承担，AI 只处理可结构化任务。
risks: Chefs and head cooks领域的责任与合规边界压力。
可结构化任务被 AI 加速替代。
行业波动与编制/岗位收紧。
知识更新快，需持续补课。
跨角色协作的沟通成本。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 把低风险拆成「可学 + 可控」两块：可学的是方法，可控的是流程与合规。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but the combination of volatility and old methods. People who rely only on past experience are the first to fall behind smart agriculture.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI but volatility. Weather, prices, and labor change every year, placing the most pressure on entry-level workers who rely only on old methods. Those who can interpret data, schedule work, and make business decisions are the ones most likely to remain.
risks: People using only old methods are declining

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how well models issue alerts, people must still inspect the land and decide whether to irrigate the east field or harvest the south slope first, how to withstand a disaster year, and how to balance the books. Agriculture cannot remove the human gatekeeper who turns data into a harvest.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「波动 + 老办法」——只会按老经验种的人最先被智慧农业甩开。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「波动」——天气、价格与用工年年变，初级只按老办法种的人最承压；真正留下来的是能看数据、能排活、能做经营决策的人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管模型多能预警，东头先灌还是南坡先收、灾年怎么扛、账怎么平，还得人下地合计去担——农业这头，从数据到收成的把关人撤不干净。

Depends on event and channel execution
Built on accumulated relationships and reputation

career_risk_cards.callout: The central risk is the combined pressure of trust and performance, not AI. AI can handle execution, but it cannot make the major-gift ask in person. This assessment supports exploration, not an employment decision.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI but donor trust and regulatory compliance. Fundraising depends on long-term relationships, and a data breach or improper solicitation can destroy years of credibility. Economic downturns also reduce donation budgets and increase performance pressure.
risks: Performance pressure: annual fundraising targets keep rising
Trust risk: a single scandal can destroy years of credibility
Economic cycles: donation budgets shrink during downturns
Sector pay: nonprofit roles generally pay less than commercial work

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can identify likely donors and draft compelling copy, but the moment when a donor agrees across the table still belongs to the person making the ask.

responsibilities: Develop and execute annual fundraising plans
Plan campaigns and expand fundraising channels
Maintain donor relationships and segmented engagement
Manage budgets and data and issue reports

career_risk_cards.callout: 筹款经理最大的风险不是 AI，而是「信任与业绩的双重压力」——AI 能替你做执行，但替不了你在大额捐赠人面前的那次开口。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「捐赠人信任与政策合规」：筹款靠的是长期关系，一次数据泄露或违规募捐就能毁掉多年口碑；同时经济下行期捐赠预算收缩，对筹款人的业绩压力很大。
risks: 业绩压力：筹款目标年年涨
信任风险：一次丑闻毁多年口碑
经济波动：下行期捐赠预算收缩
职业倦怠：长期面对拒绝与质疑
行业薪资：公益岗整体低于市场

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能帮你筛出最可能掏钱的人、写好最动人的文案，但那个「在饭桌上让捐赠人点头」的瞬间，永远只属于站在对面的人。

responsibilities: 制定并执行年度筹款计划
策划募捐活动并拓展渠道
维护捐赠人关系与分层运营
管理预算数据并出具报告

risks: Organizational flattening reduces roles that mainly transmit information.
Digital platforms replace manual follow-up, reporting, and routine coordination.
Metric-driven systems can create blame and short-term behavior when leaders use them without judgment.

Lead teams and remain accountable for results

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「中层压缩 + 指标压力」——纯协调岗在消失，价值在业务型操盘。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「组织扁平化 + 中层压缩」——协同平台和自动化让一部分协调职能下沉，纯传声筒式管理岗在减少。
risks: 协同平台替代协调动作

career_path_block.说明: Physically demanding work with slow advancement
Combines professional expertise with team leadership
Software and AI skills are highly valued

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest risk for Geological Technicians is industry cyclicality. AI changes the tools, while oil and mineral prices determine employment demand.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest career risk is not AI, but industry cycles and demanding fieldwork. Oil, gas, and mining follow commodity cycles, so projects contract during downturns. Extended work in remote areas also places pressure on workers and families.
risks: Industry cycles: oil, gas, and mining depend strongly on commodities
Demanding fieldwork: extended assignments in remote locations
Competition in data roles: AI reduces work limited to organization
Income volatility: industry conditions determine bonuses
Safety risks: field and wellsite operations

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can interpret well logs and identify oil-bearing intervals, but technicians on site still judge whether a core is reliable and whether data requires repetition. Human quality assurance remains essential to understanding the subsurface.

responsibilities: Conduct field sampling and core logging

career_risk_cards.callout: 地质技术员最大的风险不是 AI，而是「行业周期」——AI 改变的是工具，油价和矿价改变的才是饭碗。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「行业周期与野外辛苦」——油气和矿业都跟着大宗商品周期走，行业低迷时项目收缩；同时野外作业占比高，偏远地区一待就是数月，对家庭和个人是考验。

收入波动：景气度决定奖金
安全风险：野外与井场作业

Electrical and refrigerant hazards: energized work and high pressure
Continuous peak-season work causes fatigue and sleep disruption

Seasonal income fluctuation, with clear slow-season declines

responsibilities: Charge refrigerant and test for leaks
Perform scheduled maintenance and document work

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「高空和电气」——这是高危工种，安全意识和防护装备就是饭碗的底线。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「高空作业与电气风险」——室外机安装动辄几层楼高，带电作业和制冷剂压力都有安全隐患，安全规范一点不能省。
risks: 高空作业坠落风险，安全绳一点不能省
电气与制冷剂风险：带电作业、高压压力
旺季连轴转，身体疲劳与作息紊乱
纯装机工被智能设备与流水化挤压
收入季节波动，淡季收入明显下滑

career_risk_cards.callout: History's greatest risks are scarce positions and academic competition, not AI. AI can organize sources but cannot publish papers or win projects for you, and those remain hard academic thresholds.

risks: Scarce positions: far more candidates than university openings
Academic competition: intense publication and project pressure
Limited income: modest starting pay in public institutions

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how smart the system becomes, an officer still has to inspect which vehicle deserves a notice, judge when to mediate, and identify the most disorderly road sections. People cannot be removed completely from order enforcement.

career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is not AI, but automated matching plus digital records. Automated fingerprint identification and electronic case files accelerate routine data entry, while field collection, assessment of questionable evidence, and chain-of-custody management still depend on people.
risks: Electronic case files replace manual processes

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent systems become, an examiner's eyes must still find which fingerprint to collect and where a clue matches, while their judgment and hands must identify and protect a broken chain in a case file. People cannot be fully removed from the evidence process.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「自动比对 + 数字档案」——常规录入被外移，有判定力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「自动比对 + 数字档案」——指纹自动识别与电子卷宗把常规录入提速，但现场提取、疑点判定与链条管理仍靠人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪枚指纹该提、哪条线索对得上、哪份卷宗链断了，最后还是鉴定员的眼去查、脑去断、手去守——证据这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest occupational risk is not AI but heat and safety. Around molten iron, the consequences of one lapse can be irreversible.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is not AI but heat and safety. Molten iron splashes, burns, and explosions are real hazards, while foundry dust and heat can also harm workers' health.
risks: High risk of molten iron splashes, burns, and explosions
Hot, dusty conditions harm the body
Manual jobs decline as the industry adjusts
Rotating three-shift schedule with irregular hours
Heavy physical labor wears down the joints

page.contract_project_risk_block: Automated pouring lines can hold parameters steady, but when molten iron enters the mold, an experienced caster still has to judge the splashing, sound, and conditions on site.

responsibilities: Operate equipment to complete pouring and forming
Control pouring parameters to prevent defects
Complete cooling, shakeout, and initial inspection
Follow safety procedures and maintain equipment

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「高温与安全」——铁水面前，一次疏忽的代价可能无法挽回。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「高温与安全」——铁水飞溅、烫伤、爆炸风险真实存在，铸造行业粉尘和高温环境对身体的损耗也大。
risks: 铁水飞溅、烫伤、爆炸风险高
行业调整期，手工岗位减少

page.contract_project_risk_block: 自动浇注线能守住参数，但铁水浇进模具那一刻的飞溅、声音和现场判断，还得老铸工心里有杆秤。

responsibilities: 操作设备完成浇注成型
执行安全规程并维护设备

career_path_block.说明: Defines pathways and leads multinational work

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but one regulatory change forcing complete rework. Every document you write is connected to launch timing.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is not AI but regulatory change + submission failure. A policy change can force complete document rework, while blockage of a core product's registration directly affects launch timing and company revenue.
risks: Frequent regulatory changes and repeated document rework
Submission delays directly affect product launch
AI and standardized processes compress entry-level document roles

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how fast searches become, people still decide product classification, submission pathways, and how to negotiate with reviewers. Machines will not sign in regulatory gray areas.

responsibilities: Prepare and submit registration and filing materials
Track review progress and respond to comments
Alert internal teams to regulatory changes

career_path_block.说明: 被 AI 与模板替代

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「法规一改、全盘返工」——你写的每一份资料都连着上市节奏。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「法规变动 + 申报失败」——监管政策一改，整套资料要返工；一款主力产品注册被卡，直接影响上市节奏和公司收入。
risks: 法规频繁变动，资料反复返工
申报被卡直接影响产品上市
入门资料岗被 AI 与流程标准化压缩

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管检索多快，产品归哪类、该怎么报、和审评怎么谈，最后还得人定——法规的模糊地带，机器不敢签字。

responsibilities: 准备并提交注册与备案资料
跟踪审评进度并回复意见
skills: 临床与安全性数据整理

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but standardized assessment + file systems. Systems absorb assessments, while people who plan and connect resources become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk in this role is not AI but standardized assessment + file systems. Systems absorb routine assessments, but empathy, goal setting, and resource connections still need people.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent systems become, counselors still use their minds, feet, and hearts to decide goals, connect resources, and accompany people. People cannot be fully removed from rehabilitation.

responsibilities: Coordinate and close the follow-up loop

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「标准化评估 + 档案系统」——测评被系统吃，会规划链资源的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「标准化评估 + 档案系统」——常规测评被系统吃掉，但共情、目标设定与资源链接仍要人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，目标怎么定、资源怎么链、人怎么陪，最后还是咨询师的脑去想、脚去跑、心去暖——康复这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but systemization + outsourcing. Tools absorb monitoring and outsourcing drives down prices, while strong responders become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest job risk is not AI, but systemization + outsourcing. Smart surveillance and automated access control absorb some screen-monitoring roles, while labor outsourcing suppresses compensation. On-site response and deterrence remain difficult to replace.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how clear cameras become, guards still decide who should enter, how to stabilize the site, and how to respond to emergencies. Their eyes watch, feet patrol, and voices call out.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「系统化 + 外包」——盯屏被工具吃、外包压价，有处置力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「系统化 + 外包」——智能监控和自动门禁吃掉部分盯屏岗，且人力外包压低待遇；但现场处置与威慑难被完全替代。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管摄像头多清楚，谁该进、现场怎么稳、突发怎么处置，最后还是保安的眼去盯、脚去走、嘴去喊——安全这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is AI replacing data analysis and reports, traditionally the planner's core workload. The path forward is plan tradeoffs, public communication, and multi-agency coordination: let AI perform the work while you decide.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is AI's extensive replacement of data analysis and report writing. Modeling and reports are exactly where AI excels. Planners who do not advance toward plan judgment, public participation, and agency coordination are readily compressed.
risks: AI replacement: AI takes over substantial data modeling and report work
Overtime pressure: Deadline-driven document preparation is routine
Credential competition: Advancement depends on registration and project experience
Shrinking execution roles: Pure technical positions are reduced
Communication pressure: Hearings and multi-party negotiations are emotionally demanding

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can run three transit-network plans overnight and produce a polished report, but planners still have to balance a plan that residents along the route will accept, the transit operator can afford, and leaders can understand. AI generates options; people decide. This is the occupation's new division of labor.

responsibilities: Conduct transportation surveys and data analysis
Prepare reports and participate in public consultation

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险是 AI 对「数据分析与报告」的替代——这两块恰是规划师的传统主食。往方案权衡、公众沟通、多部门协调走，让 AI 干活、你拍板，才是出路。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是 AI 对「数据分析与报告撰写」的高度替代——建模和报告这两块正是 AI 最擅长的；不往方案判断、公众参与和部门协调方向升级，很容易被压缩。
risks: AI 替代：数据建模与报告被 AI 大幅接管
加班压力：项目节点赶材料常态
职称内卷：晋升看注册与项目履历
执行岗收缩：纯技术岗被压缩
沟通压力：听证与多方博弈耗心力

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能在一晚上跑完三个公交线网方案、写出一份漂亮报告，但「这个方案要让沿线居民不炸锅、让公交公司不亏钱、让领导听得懂」，这一步还得规划师来权衡——AI 出方案，人做决断，这就是这个职业的新分工。

responsibilities: 开展交通调查与数据分析
编制报告并参与公众征询
